pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; head held high and level, looking directly forward.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The entire neck is stacked vertically.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Tower' shot, looking significantly up the length of the neck to emphasize its extreme height.
pose_constraints.grounding: All four massive feet firmly planted on flat, grey-green silty soil; body entirely obscured by the neck and chest.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The entire torso and tail are hidden behind the chest and the extremely long, vertical neck. Silhouette width max 280px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The small head must be perfectly centered at the top of the very tall, straight neck, with the nostrils clearly visible.

character_details.expression: Gentle, serene gaze; small, bright eyes with a friendly, curious expression.
character_details.texture: Smooth, elephantine skin with subtle, rounded scales. Soft grey-green tones with light-catching highlights.
features: Incredibly long, vertical neck dominating the frame.
Small, delicate head relative to body size.
Nostrils positioned at the top of the head.

environmental_details.ground: Flat, grey-green siltstone with subtle damp textures, characteristic of the Shaximiao floodplains.
flora: Jurassic conifers (e.g., Araucaria, Ginkgos) in the soft-focus, low-lying background to provide scale without obscuring the neck
environmental_details.sky: Clear, bright Jurassic sky with a warm, hazy horizon; emphasizing the towering height of the dinosaur.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Sunny Exposed Cinematic' lighting with warm rim-light on the sides of the neck, maintaining the friendly animated feature style.
